registered_before: any timed arm of this row

source_of_prices.census: c12-linear-fusion-census, call census of the 512 aa boltz2 fold at 1350 MHz
source_of_prices.per_step_base: perf/roof_difftx, 15.0004 ms per sampling step on a Blackhole p150a
source_of_prices.fold_base: 14.881 s, 512 aa cdk2x2, p300c at 1350 MHz

mechanism.claim: the win is the deleted layer_norms, not the concatenated projections

predicted_block.primary_quantity: block seconds per fold, hoist vs base, summed over the 200 token-level DiffusionTransformer calls
predicted_block.ratio_caveat: the block wall inserts two ttnn.synchronize_device calls per block, which adds the same constant to both arms. That inflates the denominator, so any measured ratio is an ATTENUATED version of the true one. The pre-registered invariant is therefore the DELTA in seconds, not the ratio.
predicted_block.why: 48 deleted layer_norms and 144 regrouped projections all live inside the token-level DiffusionTransformer call, so a wall around that call sees the whole mechanism and none of the trunk, the atom encoder/decoder, the confidence head or the host-side write.

predicted_fold.admissible_because: 0.1445 s is 2.6x the 0.055 s A/A fold floor
predicted_fold.unit: the SESSION is the independent unit; a rep-level CI from one session understated by ~2.2x in b2z2-cond-hoist-ship

kill_criteria.a: block ratio sits inside 1.000 +/- its own interleaved A/A on DiffusionTransformer -> NO-GO
kill_criteria.b: block moves but composes to < 0.10 s of fold once the block share of the fold is priced -> NO-GO (parent standing bar)

go_criteria: a block win composing to >= 0.10 s of fold, reproduced across >= 2 sessions, with the A/A control in the SAME arm list as the lever

witness_required.hoist_norms: 200 on every hoist arm, 0 on every base arm
witness_required.block_n: 200 token-level DiffusionTransformer calls per fold, every arm

accuracy.status: already measured favourable by b2z2-cond-hoist-ship, not re-spent here
